messages.text: What is blocking the Northwind rollout?

SSO. Northwind loves the export feature but needs SSO before a company-wide rollout [meeting:44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444@0:00]. You owe them the security overview and a 250-seat quote this week. SSO scope itself is already locked: SAML and OIDC in Q3, SCIM out [meeting:00000015-0000-4000-8000-000000000015@0:00].
